examples_zh: 请把我提供的活动安排写成一份可直接转发的通知，讲清参加事项和办理要求，只输出通知正文。
请根据我提供的采购需求、报价和经费情况，起草一份设备采购请示，重点写清采购理由、主要内容和请求批准的事项。
请把本阶段工作记录整理成工作总结，突出重点和代表性成果，合并重复内容，已有安排与下一步建议分别表述。
请把我提供的会议记录整理成会议纪要，提炼议定事项，按记录写清责任分工和办理期限，保留尚未议定事项的状态。
请把这份汇报压缩到800字以内，保留关键事实、数字和原意，删去重复铺陈，语言平实自然，返回完整改后稿。
请审校这份公文，按“位置、问题、修改建议”列出意见，区分明确错误、待核实信息和可选的表达优化。
examples_en: Turn the activity arrangements I provide into a Chinese notice ready to forward. Explain participation details and required actions, and return only the notice.
Use the procurement needs, quotations, and funding information I provide to draft a Chinese request for approval to purchase equipment. Explain the reasons, scope, and approval requested.

Turn my work records for this period into a Chinese work summary. Highlight priorities and representative results, combine repeated points, and distinguish existing plans from recommendations for next steps.
Turn the meeting notes I provide into formal Chinese minutes. Extract agreed items, include responsibilities and deadlines stated in the notes, and preserve the status of unresolved matters.
Condense this Chinese report to 800 characters or fewer. Preserve its key facts, figures, and meaning, remove repetition, and return the full revised draft in plain, natural Chinese.

Review this Chinese official document. List the location, issue, and suggested revision for each comment, distinguishing definite errors, information needing verification, and optional wording improvements.
